arxiv-2404-10304.title: LLM-Powered Test Case Generation for Detecting Bugs in Plausible Programs
arxiv-2404-10304.creator: Kaibo Liu, Zhenpeng Chen, Yiyang Liu, Jie M. Zhang, Mark Harman, Yudong Han, Yun Ma, Yihong Dong, Ge Li, Gang Huang
arxiv-2404-10304.description: Abstract Detecting tricky bugs in plausible programs, those that pass existing test suites yet still contain bugs, remains a significant challenge in software testing. To address this problem, we propose TrickCatcher, an LLM-powered approach to generating test cases for uncovering bugs in plausible programs.

arxiv-2405-01282.title: Oort’s conjecture and automorphisms of supersingular curves of genus four
arxiv-2405-01282.creator: Dušan Dragutinović
arxiv-2405-01282.description: Abstract . We show that every component of the locus of smooth supersingular curves of genus 4 4 in characteristic p > 2 p>2 has a trivial generic automorphism group. As a result, we prove Oort’s conjecture about automorphism groups of supersingular abelian fourfolds for p > 2 p>2 .

arxiv-2504-02496.description: Abstract Recent advances in image captioning have focused on enhancing accuracy by substantially increasing the dataset and model size. pmc-10730219.creator: Howard J Worman, Susan Michaelis
pmc-10730219.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). As human longevity increases, understanding the molecular mechanisms that drive aging becomes ever more critical to promote health and prevent age-related disorders. Premature aging disorders or progeroid syndromes can provide critical insights into aspects of physiological aging. A major cause of progeroid syndromes which result from mutations in the genes LMNA and ZMPSTE24 is disruption of the final posttranslational processing step in the production of the nuclear scaffold protein lamin A.

This work investigates the relationship between the mean diameter of palladium (Pd) nanoparticles and their surface energy, specifically in the context of alkaline ethanol electro-oxidation for fuel cell applications. Employing a recent generalization of the classical Laviron equation, we derive crucial parameters such as surface energy (σ), adsorption–desorption equilibrium constant (Keq), and electron transfer coefficient (α) from linear voltammograms obtained from Pd-based nanoparticles supported on Vulcan carbon.

pmc-12678889.description: Kataveni et al’s meta-analysis offers an important contemporary synthesis of randomized evidence comparing fractional flow reserve-guided percutaneous coronary intervention and coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG) in multivessel coronary artery disease (CAD). pmc-13578207.title: Sports tourism as a pathway to older adults’ psychological well-being: a dual-pathway model integrating broaden-and-build and social identity perspectives
pmc-13578207.creator: Baoxia Chen, Zhenguo Shi, Qian Sun
pmc-13578207.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This study explores how sports tourism is associated with older adults’ eudaimonic well-being through dual psychological mechanisms. Drawing on Broaden-and-Build Theory and Social Identity Theory, the research examines an emotion pathway in which positive emotions and sense of physical challenge achievement are linked to psychological resources, and an identity pathway in which sports group identification is linked to positive age identity. Survey data from 467 older Chinese sports tourism participants were analyzed using PLS-SEM and artificial neural network analysis.
